name: Gran Melia Iguazu
insider_take: The only hotel located within Iguazu National Park itself, offering exclusive after-hours access to one of the world's most spectacular waterfalls.
whats_special: Gran Meliá Iguazu is uniquely positioned inside the Argentine side of Iguazu National Park, making it the sole accommodation with direct access to the falls. Guests can explore the park before it opens and after it closes to day visitors, experiencing the thundering cascades in complete solitude. The hotel's indigenous-inspired design incorporates local Guaraní cultural elements throughout its architecture and décor.
pro_tip: Book a room with park views and wake up early to watch the sunrise over the falls from your balcony – you'll have this UNESCO World Heritage wonder virtually to yourself before the crowds arrive.
dont_miss: The hotel's private walkways lead directly to Devil's Throat (Garganta del Diablo), the most dramatic section of Iguazu Falls. Take advantage of the exclusive evening illumination of the falls, available only to hotel guests, and spot exotic wildlife like toucans and coatis roaming the hotel grounds at dusk.
pros: Prime location within Iguazu National Park with direct access to waterfalls
Luxury accommodations with rainforest views and premium amenities
Exclusive spa treatments and world-class dining experiences
Eco-friendly design integrated with natural surroundings
cons: Remote rainforest location requires planned transportation
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and unique location
